items.name: LAN speed and cable diagnostics
items.description: Inspect link speed, duplex mode and error counters; run bidirectional iperf3 tests and optional cable diagnostics.

items.name: Anki Flow legacy launcher
items.description: Archived launcher for the discontinued Anki Flow source checkout. Passes all CLI arguments through.

items.name: Historical Anki PDF to WordPress
items.description: Use the timestamp in an anki-stats-YYYY-MM-DD@HH-MM-SS.pdf filename to create or reuse WordPress posts and attachments, with timestamp readback.

items.name: Archive folder and move to Trash
items.description: Create a timestamped tar.gz archive, verify readability, then move the original folder to desktop Trash.

items.name: CalDAV Assistant native messaging host
items.description: Launch the isolated Python native_host.py used by the Thunderbird Native Messaging integration.

items.name: WordPress categories by keyword
items.description: Preview matching post titles, excerpts and content, then append a category and read the result back.

items.name: WordPress category script: old backup
items.description: Archived backup retained for comparison only. Not a preferred executable.

items.name: WordPress category script: pre-verification snapshot
items.description: Historical code snapshot from before the verification fix. Not a preferred executable.

items.name: Complete matching Anki CalDAV tasks
items.description: Find incomplete VTODOs due on the specified date whose titles match a keyword, then complete them in bulk.

items.name: WordPress subject index pages
items.description: Create or update subject tags and child pages beneath the configured parent, including a Gutenberg Query Loop.

items.name: Extract embedded PDF images
items.description: Extract bitmap images from a PDF or a directory of PDFs. Duplicate images are removed by default.

items.name: Import WeChat exports into WordPress
items.description: Synchronize exported assets to WordPress uploads and create or update posts embedding messages-unlocked.html. Contains private chat data.

items.name: Person mosaic launcher
items.description: Forward arguments to person_mosaic.py in an external virtual environment. The actual application is not bundled.

items.name: Podman Compose pipx launcher
items.description: Forward CLI arguments to podman_compose.main in its external pipx environment.

items.name: Thunderbird experiment: back up and launch
items.description: Check running Thunderbird processes, back up the experimental TaskFix profile, then launch the isolated experimental build.

items.name: Restore latest Thunderbird experiment backup
items.description: Restore a TaskFix profile from the latest before-experiment backup after backing up the current profile. Requires YES confirmation.

items.name: Thunderbird experiment: legacy profile snapshot
items.description: Historical launcher using the old profile path. Retained only for reference.

items.name: Thunderbird TaskFix launcher
items.description: Launch the fixed TaskFix build with its isolated profile, or explicitly choose the system profile.

items.name: Thunderbird TaskFix Clean launcher
items.description: Launch TaskFix Clean with its isolated application and profile.

items.name: Thunderbird TaskFix Recurring Safe launcher
items.description: Launch Recurring Safe TaskFix with its isolated profile, or explicitly choose the system profile.

items.name: Process WeChat export HTML restrictions
items.description: Process conversations/*/messages.html and generate messages-unlocked.html by removing recognized integrity checks and hidden elements.

items.name: vdirsyncer pipx launcher
items.description: Launch the third-party vdirsyncer CLI in its external pipx environment for calendar and contact synchronization.

items.name: Website application-menu entry
items.description: Fetch a website title and favicon and create a Linux Mint/Cinnamon desktop menu entry for the URL.

items.name: WordPress read-only diagnostics
items.description: Collect system logs, service status, recently modified file metadata and HTTP checks into a text diagnostic report.
